# sheet.close

Take a sheet down. Nobody can join it after this.

**Who may call:** anyone.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| sheet | sheet.id |

## Answer

(none)

## Move

`close`: from open or full to closed, emitting SheetClosed.

## Steps

- `sheet.close.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| SheetNotOpen | 70 | SH-900 | the sheet is in a state close can't start from; carries `state` |

## How to call

```sh
signup sheet close --sheet <sheet>
```

HTTP: `POST /sheet/close` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.sheet.close(payload)`.

# sheet

A sign-up sheet with a fixed number of places.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value |
|---|---|
| id | id |
| title | Title |
| places | Count |
| taken | Count |

## Machine

States: open, full, closed. A move from the wrong state is refused SheetNotOpen (exit 70).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| open | (creates) | open | SheetOpened |
| join | open | open, full | PlaceTaken |
| close | open, full | closed | SheetClosed |

## Operations

- [sheet.close](close.md): Take a sheet down. Nobody can join it after this.
- [sheet.get](get.md): Read one sheet by its id: title, places, taken, state.
- [sheet.join](join.md): Take places on a sheet, for yourself and anyone with you.
- [sheet.open](open.md): Put up a sheet with a number of places.

# sheet.join

Take places on a sheet, for yourself and anyone with you.

**Who may call:** anyone.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| sheet | sheet.id |
| people | Count |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| left | Count |

## Move

`join`: from open to open or full, emitting PlaceTaken.

## Steps

- `sheet.join.load` (database)
- `sheet.join.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| SheetFull | 71 | SH-001 | declared in errors.ts, carrying left |
| SheetNotOpen | 70 | SH-900 | the sheet is in a state join can't start from; carries `state` |

## How to call

```sh
signup sheet join --sheet <sheet> --people <people>
```

HTTP: `POST /sheet/join` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.sheet.join(payload)`.
